start.title: [TODO:de] On the Road
start.text:
[TODO:de] The pilgrims walk toward Jerusalem.
The feast of Passover draws near.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Run ahead alone, far from them
[TODO:de] Refuse to go to the feast

stray_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Walk Together
stray_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The road is long and crowded.
Stay near your parents.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Honor the Feast
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Passover is the holy memory of God.
You must go.

temple.title: [TODO:de] The Temple Courts
temple.text:
[TODO:de] Sunlight falls on the great stones.
Voices of teachers fill the air.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Enter and listen to the teachers
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You step inside, drawn to the words.

market_consequence.title: [TODO:de] His Father's House
market_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The temple is your true place.
Go where wisdom is spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Enter and listen to the teachers

stay.title: [TODO:de] When the Caravan Leaves
stay.text:
[TODO:de] The pilgrims begin to depart.
The teachers still speak of God.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay to hear the words of God
[TODO:de] Hide in the streets to play

follow_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay and Learn
follow_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The Father's house holds you.
You are meant to remain.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay to hear the words of God

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Sacred Time
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Wisdom does not wait for play.
Return to the temple.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay to hear the words of God

search.title: [TODO:de] They Are Searching
search.text:
[TODO:de] Three days pass in the temple.
Mary and Joseph walk Jerusalem in fear.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Slip away and hide from them
[TODO:de] Remain where they will find you

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Found
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] They love you and seek you.
Wait where you belong.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Remain where they will find you

teachers.title: [TODO:de] Among the Wise
teachers.text:
[TODO:de] The elders ask many questions.
They wait for your answer.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Speak Gently
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Truth lives within you.
Let it be heard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your soft voice fills the room.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Wisdom is not for boasting.
Speak with quiet grace.

reunion.title: [TODO:de] Mary Finds You
reunion.text:
[TODO:de] She weeps:
"Why have you done this to us?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] She holds the words in her heart.
[TODO:de] Do not run from her love.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Speak with Love
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] She is your mother.
Answer her with grace.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay With Her
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] She has searched three days.
Give her the truth.

return.title: [TODO:de] Home to Nazareth
return.text:
[TODO:de] You walk with them under the dawn.
You grow in wisdom and grace.
